sections.heading: How to Play Feral
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Feral"][color=C11]Feral Druid Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]
Feral has a reputation for being complicated and overwhelming because it's fairly unique among melee specs. If you follow a few simple rules, the spec should be far more accessible. Feral is an Energy Combo Point spec that maintains a variety of debuffs.


[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_mount_jungletiger  size=medium type=round color=C11 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=C11]Avoid Wasting resources:[/color][/b] Energy specs have a finite number of resources for any set time period. It's important to avoid wasting these resources, either through misuse of [spell=5217] or natural over-capping.
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_ghoulfrenzy   size=medium type=round color=C11 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=C11]Maintain Debuffs:[/color][/b] Feral's damage over time effects are generally the most efficient spells you can cast. [spell=1079], [spell=1822] and if talented [spell=155625] are the most energy efficient spells Feral has. 
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_druid_berserk  size=medium type=round color=C11 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=C11]Sync your Cooldowns:[/color][/b] Feral can have a wide range of different cooldowns with varying cooldown lengths. It's important to sync these together as much as possible without losing out on uses of them..[/td]
	[/tr]
[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=32937 icon=ability_druid_catform]Feral Druid Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Rotation Priority

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=C11][icon name=ability_druid_catform type=round size=medium inline=true color=C11][/icon] Feral Druid Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]

[pad]
[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]

[tab name="Berserk" icon=ability_druid_berserk]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=C11] Berserk [/color][/h3]
[spell=106951] has both a simple % damage increase and an additional effect, causing you to gain a free Combo Point every 1.5 seconds and your generators to generate an additional Combo Point. While [spell=106951] is active, you gain a Combo Point buffer for the duration. Any Combo Points you gain over the cap of 5 are converted into a buff, and when you spend Combo Points and return to 0, that buff is converted into Combo Points.

[ul]
[li]When talented into [spell=102543] it replaces [spell=106951] granting the same effects for 20 seconds but additionally reducing all energy costs by 25% and allowing you a single use of [spell=5215] in combat during the duration.
[/li]

[li]If talented into [spell=449537] the effect doesn't trigger until you exceed the overflow Combo Points.[/li]
[/ul]
[hr]
For [symbol=wow-hero-talent-druid-of-the-claw] [b][color=c6]Druid of the Claw[/color][/b] the [spell=106951] window is a significant portion of your overall damage due to [spell=441835] allowing you to generate significant extra [spell=441583] procs..
[/tab]

[tab name="Convoke the Spirits" icon=inv_ability_druid_convokethespirits]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=C11] Convoke the Spirits [/color][/h3]
[spell=323764] - This ability casts 16 spells, 10 of which are form specific spells, with the rest being distributed between non-form-specific spells. This ability does have a degree of variance to it, which can be frustrating. [spell=323764] will try and avoid casting most DoTs if they are already applied to the target.
The spell casts a mix of:

[b]Cat Specific[/b]
[ul]
[li][spell=22568][/li]

[li][spell=1822][/li]
[li][spell=5221][/li]
[/ul]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=C11][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=C11][/icon] Feral Druid Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]
The main thing that most new Feral Druids struggle with in the rotation is adjusting to a spec where your pace is determined by resources rather than GCDs. As Feral you'll need to get used to not casting a spell with every GCD, at times you'll have to wait for energy to cast spells or maximise the effectiveness of spells.


[pad]
[tabs name="advanced" uniform=true iconborders=true]
    [tab name="Pandemic and Snapshotting" icon=ability_ghoulfrenzy]
        [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=C11] Pandemic and Snapshotting[/color][/h3]
        Pandemic and snapshotting are two core feral mechanics that aren't really mentioned explicitly when learning the class. 
        [h4]Pandemic[/h4]
        Pandemic is a hidden mechanic in the game whereby if you refresh a dot or certain buffs up to 30% of the duration of the buff/debuff is added onto the next cast.
        So if you take [spell=1822] which has a base duration of 15 seconds, if you refresh [spell=1822] with 5 seconds left on the duration, just under 5 seconds will be added onto your next cast. It's important to note that the only thing that is added on is duration, this resets the snapshot for the full duration of the newly applied dot.
        [h4]Snapshotting[/h4]
        What is snapshotting, snapshotting is for most classes historical. Feral however still has a few interactions. [spell=5217] and [spell=390772], when a dot is applied during these effects the effect is applied to the full duration of the spell. If you cast a [spell=1822], or [spell=1079] during [spell=5217] then the entire duration of the dot will be affected by the buff, even when you no longer have the buff active.
    [/tab]
    [tab name="Ferocious Bite" icon=ability_druid_ferociousbite]
        [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=C11] Ferocious Bite [/color][/h3]
        [spell=22568] has a mechanic whereby it will deal bonus damage based on extra energy spent. By default [spell=22568] will spend 25 energy with up to 100% extra damage at 25 additional energy spent for a total of 50 energy spent. With the changes in 12.0.5 this once again becomes a relevant mechanic, you'll allways want to cast with 5 combo points and 50 energy. 
    [/tab]
    [tab name="Chomp" icon=inv_1115_druid_jaguar]
        [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=C11] Chomp [/color][/h3]
        [spell=1244258] is a unique spell that might take some getting accustomed too. Experienced Ferals will be familiar with Pooling, ensuring you have enough energy for CDs or to generate after a finisher. [spell=1244258] requires you to think similarly but in reverse. You'll need to ensure that, as [spell=1244258] comes off cooldown, you're low enough energy to cast it on cooldown.
    [/tab]
[/tabs]
